Senior Platform Engineer

Remote (Europe) · Full-time

About the role

Northwind is looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to design, build and run the infrastructure that hundreds of product engineers deploy to every day. You will own our Kubernetes platform, our CI/CD pipelines and the developer tooling around them.

What you'll do

  • Design and operate multi-region Kubernetes clusters on AWS
  • Build self-service deployment tooling in Go and Python
  • Lead incident reviews and improve reliability across teams
  • Mentor engineers and collaborate with product teams on their infrastructure needs

Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in infrastructure or platform engineering
  • Strong experience with Kubernetes, Terraform and AWS
  • Proficiency in Go or Python

Nice to have

  • Experience with service meshes such as Istio or Linkerd

What we offer

Competitive salary, remote-first team, learning budget and 30 days of holiday.
